summary: The CloudTrail rulebook has sources, rules and actions. Rule 1 fires on UpdateTrail with empty kmsKeyId for the named trail and runs aws_restore_cloudtrail_encryption.yml (role cloud.aws_ops.enable_cloudtrail_encryption_with_kms); rule 2 fires on DeleteTrail and runs aws_restore_cloudtrail.yml (awsconfig_multiregion_cloudtrail, then encryption).
questions: How can EDA re-enable CloudTrail encryption automatically?
EDA rule to re-create a deleted CloudTrail trail
What are sources, rules and actions in a rulebook?

answer_card.title: EDA rulebook to keep CloudTrail encrypted
answer_card.answer_md:
| Rule | Condition | Action |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Re-enable encryption | `UpdateTrail` with `requestParameters.kmsKeyId == ""` and name == `vars.cloudtrail_name` | `playbooks/eda/aws_restore_cloudtrail_encryption.yml` (role `cloud.aws_ops.enable_cloudtrail_encryption_with_kms`) |
| 2. Re-create trail | `eventName == "DeleteTrail"` and name == `vars.cloudtrail_name` | `playbooks/eda/aws_restore_cloudtrail.yml` (`cloud.aws_ops.awsconfig_multiregion_cloudtrail`, then the encryption role) |
| 3. Restore KMS key | `ScheduleKeyDeletion` or `DisableKey` | `playbooks/eda/aws_restore_kms_key.yml` |
